title: Correct tension magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for the tension force must be 0.5 N.

title: Correct deflection angle
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for the angle θ must be 37°.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the vertical (mg) and horizontal (kv²) forces acting on the ball in equilibrium.

title: Tension calculation method
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use the Pythagorean theorem or vector addition to find the tension from the vertical and horizontal force components.

title: Angle calculation method
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use a trigonometric function (e.g., cosθ = mg/T or tanθ = F_wind/mg) to relate the forces to the angle θ.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should correctly handle unit conversions, such as converting mass from grams to kilograms.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the solution incorrectly treats the tension as equal to just mg or just the wind force, ignoring vector nature.

title: Incorrect force law application
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the wind force F = kv² is calculated incorrectly, or if the value of k is misused.
